Per curriculum/vocabulary.md § The work (canonical source this rule points to): 'Noun-run for the agent sitting is banned in student-facing body — engineers don't say it,' legal only as test/CI/eval executions, verbatim quotes, artifact/path/branch names, or the adjective 'long-running'.
